  Bachelor’s Degree + PGDCA / NIELIT ‘A’ Level + software development & networking proficiency.

  Bachelor’s Degree + Diploma in Computer Science / NIELIT ‘O’ Level + Hindi/English Data Entry knowledge + Typing speed 25 WPM Hindi & 40 WPM English.
